ideas.title: Chez Boulay - Bistro Boréal
ideas.description: Enjoy a seasonal dinner featuring regional boreal ingredients and Nordic-inspired Quebecois cuisine.

ideas.title: Le Grand Marché de Québec
ideas.description: Sample artisan cheeses, maple treats, and local delicacies from regional vendors at the central public market.

ideas.title: Le Chic Shack
ideas.description: Indulge in gourmet poutines paired with local craft beers and artisanal milkshakes near Château Frontenac.

ideas.title: Old Quebec Exploration
ideas.description: Capture the historic European charm of Dufferin Terrace and Quartier Petit Champlain dusted in early winter scenery.

ideas.title: Montmorency Falls Park
ideas.description: Photograph the dramatic frozen edges of the massive waterfall via the suspension bridge and cable car.

ideas.title: Plains of Abraham
ideas.description: Snap moody, wide landscape shots of the sprawling historic parkland overlooking the Saint Lawrence River.

ideas.title: Stroll Through Old Quebec
ideas.description: Walk along the historic cobblestone streets of UNESCO-listed Old Quebec to admire the European-style architecture and early festive winter decorations.

ideas.title: Visit Fairmont Le Château Frontenac
ideas.description: Explore the majestic grounds of the world's most photographed hotel and enjoy panoramic views of the St. Lawrence River from Dufferin Terrace.

ideas.title: Admire Montmorency Falls Park
ideas.description: Take a short drive outside the city to witness the towering frozen-edged waterfall via suspension bridges and scenic viewing platforms.

ideas.title: Neapolitan Pizza Tasting at Nina Pizza Napolitaine
ideas.description: Enjoy authentic wood-fired Neapolitan pizzas with fresh ingredients in the trendy Saint-Roch neighborhood.

ideas.title: Artisanal Pizza and Wine at Pizzeria No. 900 Saint-Jean
ideas.description: Savor certified Neapolitan-style pizzas paired with fine wines right on historic Rue Saint-Jean.

ideas.title: Craft Beer and Wood-Fired Pizza at Microbrasserie La Souche Limoilou
ideas.description: Pair locally brewed Quebec craft beers with gourmet wood-fired pizzas in a cozy pub setting.
